purpose: Describe all byte-level components needed to turn an IA-32 instruction definition into a decoder lookup entry.

sib.present_when: 32-bit addressing with ModR/M rm=100 and mod!=11

components.operand_size: 16 or 32 bits in i386; 66h toggles the default operand size.
components.address_size: 16 or 32 bits in i386; 67h toggles the default address size.
components.implicit_operands: Allow fixed registers such as EAX, EDX:EAX, ESP, EIP, segment registers, flags, and string-operation indices.
components.validity: Encoding records may impose memory_only, register_only, fixed_mod, fixed_rm, fixed_reg, prefix_required, prefix_forbidden, and mode restrictions.

lookup_order: apply opcode-embedded register or fixed opcode constraints
